title: BACKLOG.md structure
description: Canonical shape of $BACKLOG_FILE, used by every radin agent/skill that reads or appends to it (radin-review, radin-record, radin-orchestrator, radin-plan). This schema documents the contract in JSON form for radin contributors — it is not read at runtime; each agent/skill embeds the concrete markdown format matching this schema directly in its own instructions, since installed skills/agents run in consumer repos that never receive this docs/ directory.

sections.description: Top-level '## <category>' sections, in canonical order feat -> fix -> chore -> refactor. A section is created only once it has its first entry; an empty backlog file has none. There is exactly one section per category — never split the same category across two headings.

category.description: Semver-style change type, same vocabulary as a conventional-commit type. Determines which section an entry lives under — there is no per-entry bracket tag anymore.

title.description: Heading text: '### <title>', directly under its category's '##' section.

description.description: Free-form prose beneath the title heading. Must be as exhaustive as the situation warrants — what the change is, why it matters, affected files/areas if known, acceptance criteria if known. radin-orchestrator/radin-plan derive scope and priority entirely from this text, so a thin one-liner starves them of what they need; write enough that a sub-agent picking up only this entry (no other session context) could act on it correctly.

plan.description: Optional trailing line(s) appended by radin-plan after it plans this entry: '**Plan:** <path>'. Normally one line; more than one means radin-plan judged the entry's scope broad enough to split into independent sub-plans, and the user confirmed the split. Valid on an entry of any category.
